# Excelsior LLC

> John Vajda is a Pain Reprocessing Therapy Coach at Excelsior LLC. Based in Boulder, Colorado. Coaching by video anywhere. Completed the Pain Reprocessing Coaching Training from the Pain Reprocessing Therapy Center (https://www.painreprocessingtherapy.com/), 2026. Coaching is not medical care. 66% of people were pain-free or nearly pain-free after trying PRT. See the Data: https://excelsior-prt.com/#data. Book a free 30 minute discovery call to see if it is a good fit.
